summary: Official Hapuppy sources conflict. The terms still describe a one-time 200K-credit signup bonus for basic models at 10 RPM. Current quickstart, Credits & Pricing and FAQ instead say there is no free tier or free credits and direct users to purchase a one-time pack; those docs list 100 RPM and require Discord account binding. The current documented OpenAI-compatible API base is https://api.hapuppy.com/v1. Do not assume a new account will receive free credits until Hapuppy resolves these conflicting terms. No signup or purchase was performed.
claim_steps: Read both https://hapuppy.com/en/terms and https://docs.hapuppy.com/guides/credits; they conflict on whether signup includes any free credit. Confirm with Hapuppy before relying on the 200K grant.
Current onboarding docs require binding a Discord account and purchasing a credit pack before generating a usable API key; this does not verify a free signup path.
If independently eligible and using the API, use the currently documented base https://api.hapuppy.com/v1. Do not assume the old beta endpoint or a free balance remains available.
